name: Gridfinity
description: Gridfinity bins (hollow, eco or solid for custom cutouts), baseplates and drawer baseplates split to fit your printer, on a full, half or custom grid.

width.title: Width (cells)
width.description: Cells along X (42 mm, 21 mm on the half grid, or the custom size). One run builds up to 100 cells, fewer with holes

depth.title: Depth (cells)
depth.description: Cells along Y (42 mm, 21 mm on the half grid, or the custom size). One run builds up to 100 cells, fewer with holes

dividers_x.title: Dividers across X
dividers_x.description: Walls splitting the bin along X (hollow bins)

dividers_y.title: Dividers across Y
dividers_y.description: Walls splitting the bin along Y (hollow bins)

inside_scoop.title: Scoop
inside_scoop.description: Rounded floor along the front wall of each compartment, so small parts slide out. Radius in mm, 0 = none (hollow bins only)

inside_fill_height.title: Fill height (solid)
inside_fill_height.description: Solid bins: where the fill stops, mm from the bottom of the bin. Above it the bin is hollow, so a bin stacked on top clears what sits in your cutout. 0 = filled to the top of the walls

inside_label_tab.title: Label tab
inside_label_tab.description: A 12 mm shelf along the back wall of each compartment, at the top, for a label (hollow bins only)

inside_label_text.title: Label text (a; b; c)
inside_label_text.description: Text on the label tab, as its own body so it can be printed in another filament. One label per compartment, separated by ; (back row first, left to right), e.g. M3x6; M3x8; Washers. Each label becomes a text parameter (Label_1, Label_2, ...): change it in Parameters to relabel. Adds the label tab (hollow bins only)

inside_label_text_size.title: Label text size
inside_label_text_size.description: Capital height of the label text. 0 = as big as fits on the tab

inside_label_text_style.title: Label text style
inside_label_text_style.description: Raised: the text stands up from the tab. Flush (inlaid): it is sunk into the tab, its top level with the tab, for a flat label in two colours

inside_label_text_font.title: Label text font
inside_label_text_font.description: An installed font, e.g. Arial, DejaVu Sans or Segoe UI. Empty = SolidCraft's built-in font. Sizes are fitted for the built-in one, so a wide font may need a smaller Label text size

inside_label_text_height.title: Label text height
inside_label_text_height.description: How far the label text stands up from the tab, or how deep it is sunk in (flush), e.g. one or two layers

inside_wall.title: Wall thickness
inside_wall.description: Thicker or thinner walls, inward: the outside stays the same. 0.4 to 5 mm, 0 = standard (0.95, eco 0.8)

holes_magnet.title: Magnet holes
holes_magnet.description: 6.5 x 2.4 mm holes in every foot

filler_left.title: Filler left
filler_left.description: Wall moved out on the left (-X), over a baseplate's filler. Flat bottom there, wide ones need support. 0 = none

filler_right.title: Filler right
filler_right.description: Wall moved out on the right (+X), over a baseplate's filler. Flat bottom there, wide ones need support. 0 = none

filler_front.title: Filler front
filler_front.description: Wall moved out on the front (-Y), over a baseplate's filler. Flat bottom there, wide ones need support. 0 = none

filler_back.title: Filler back
filler_back.description: Wall moved out on the back (+Y), over a baseplate's filler. Flat bottom there, wide ones need support. 0 = none

position_x.title: Position X
position_x.description: Corner of the bin, filler included

position_y.title: Position Y
position_y.description: Corner of the bin, filler included

stacking_lip.title: Stacking lip
stacking_lip.description: Lip on top so bins stack

title.title: Body name
title.description: Leave empty for an automatic name with the real size, e.g. Gridfinity bin 2x1x3 (83.5 x 41.5 x 25.1 mm): less the 0.5 mm gap, with filler and stacking lip

grid.title: Grid size
grid.description: Full: 42 mm feet. Half: 21 mm feet, four fit in one baseplate pocket. Custom: your own cell size, set below (fits only other parts with the same size)

inside.title: Inside
inside.description: Eco: 0.8 mm walls, hollow feet, less filament (no screw holes). Solid: filled, to cut your own shapes into

custom_size_x.title: Custom cell X
custom_size_x.description: Cell size along X, only used when Grid size is Custom

custom_size_y.title: Custom cell Y
custom_size_y.description: Cell size along Y, only used when Grid size is Custom

width.title: Width (cells)
width.description: Cells along X (42 mm, 21 mm on the half grid, or the custom size). One run builds up to 100 cells, fewer with holes

depth.title: Depth (cells)
depth.description: Cells along Y (42 mm, 21 mm on the half grid, or the custom size). One run builds up to 100 cells, fewer with holes

holes_magnet.title: Magnet holes
holes_magnet.description: 6.5 x 2.4 mm holes in every pocket (needs a solid bottom)

filler_left.title: Filler left
filler_left.description: Strip on the left (-X) side, to fill out a drawer (see Leftover space). 0 = none

filler_right.title: Filler right
filler_right.description: Strip on the right (+X) side, to fill out a drawer (see Leftover space). 0 = none

filler_front.title: Filler front
filler_front.description: Strip on the front (-Y) side, to fill out a drawer (see Leftover space). 0 = none

filler_back.title: Filler back
filler_back.description: Strip on the back (+Y) side, to fill out a drawer (see Leftover space). 0 = none

leftover.title: Leftover space
leftover.description: Half cells: pockets half a cell wide and as long as the cells (21 x 42 mm), for half-width bins, where 21 mm or more is left over; the rest solid. Solid: all solid

title.title: Body name
title.description: Leave empty for an automatic name

grid.title: Grid size
grid.description: Full: 42 mm pockets. Half: 21 mm pockets. Custom: your own cell size, set below (fits only other parts with the same size)

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: Solid floor, or just the frame (lighter, no magnet holes)

custom_size_x.title: Custom cell X
custom_size_x.description: Cell size along X, only used when Grid size is Custom

custom_size_y.title: Custom cell Y
custom_size_y.description: Cell size along Y, only used when Grid size is Custom

drawer_width.title: Drawer width
drawer_width.description: Inside width of the drawer (along X)

drawer_depth.title: Drawer depth
drawer_depth.description: Inside depth of the drawer (along Y)

printer_x.title: Printer bed X
printer_x.description: Largest piece your printer can print along X

printer_y.title: Printer bed Y
printer_y.description: Largest piece your printer can print along Y

filler_x.title: Filler along X
filler_x.description: Where the space left over beside the cells goes

filler_y.title: Filler along Y
filler_y.description: Where the space left over in front of and behind the cells goes

leftover.title: Leftover space
leftover.description: Half cells: a row of pockets half a cell wide and as long as the cells (21 x 42 mm), for half-width bins, where 21 mm or more is left over (on the side Filler names; for Even, right and back); the rest solid. Solid: all solid

grid.title: Grid size
grid.description: Full: 42 mm pockets. Half: 21 mm pockets. Custom: your own cell size, set below

custom_size_x.title: Custom cell X
custom_size_x.description: Cell size along X, only used when Grid size is Custom

custom_size_y.title: Custom cell Y
custom_size_y.description: Cell size along Y, only used when Grid size is Custom

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: Solid floor, or just the frame (lighter, no magnet holes)

holes_magnet.title: Magnet holes
holes_magnet.description: 6.5 x 2.4 mm holes in every pocket (needs a solid bottom)

title.title: Body name
title.description: Leave empty for an automatic name

piece.title: Piece (0 = all)
piece.description: Build just one piece (numbered along X, then Y). Big drawers take longer than SolidCraft allows a plugin, so build them one piece at a time

floor.title: Drawer floor
floor.description: SolidCraft 0.44+: click the drawer's floor. The plate fills it up to the walls, less 0.5 mm, and sits on it with its pieces together. Overrides width, depth and position
